methodology.timing: Public operation only; excludes module startup, setup, validation, window.close and explicit GC.
methodology.memory: Process memory after window.close, one event-loop turn and explicit GC; not peak memory or allocation totals.
methodology.compatibility: Row count, decoded text, and deterministic full-document SHA-256 are checked outside timing. Cross-engine output hashes must match. serialize-utf8 includes result consumption via Buffer.byteLength.
methodology.environments: Environment setup includes creation of a 25-row document with outside-only scripts, excludes imports and teardown, and uses an isolated globals object for the normal setup case.
methodology.nodeComparisons: Cloning and selecting comparison nodes happen before timing. Equality compares complete independent 250-row trees 100 times; position compares the last sibling with 1000 cycling peers plus containment at 250 and 1000 rows. Result checksums are asserted.
methodology.ratio: jsdom median / rustdom median; values greater than 1 favor rustdom.
methodology.limitations: Synthetic workloads on one machine. JavaScript wrappers and Web APIs remain; unsupported selectors delegate to jsdom. No claim about complete test-suite speed.
